title: Send churn-risk check-in to Acme Ops?
summary: Customer Success drafted a personal note for an account that went quiet after onboarding.
details: This sends an external email to a customer champion. The goal is to restart usage before renewal risk grows.

draft.subject: Quick check-in on your Sipher rollout
draft.body:
Hi Taylor,

I noticed the Acme team has not used the workspace much since the first onboarding session.

Would it help if I set up a 20-minute working session this week to tune the agent cards around your support workflow?

If the timing is not right, I can also send a short setup checklist your team can use async.

- Alex

title: Deploy billing export fix?
summary: Deploy Agent found the CSV timezone bug and is ready to ship a low-risk patch.
details: The patch only changes export formatting. It does not touch invoices, payments, or subscription state.

sections.title: Patch
sections.body: Normalize export timestamps to the workspace timezone before writing CSV rows.

sections.title: Validation
sections.body: Unit test covers UTC, America/New_York, and Europe/London workspaces.

details: Choose the task that should get your uninterrupted founder time today.

title: How should we answer the SOC 2 question?
summary: A 120-seat prospect asked whether Sipher has SOC 2 or an equivalent security plan.
details: The agent needs your preferred positioning before replying to avoid overpromising.

input.placeholder: Example: say SOC 2 is planned for Q3, share current controls, offer security call.

title: Choose the next pricing experiment
summary: Pricing Agent compared three experiments that could improve trial-to-paid conversion this week.
details: The recommendation is based on current traffic, engineering effort, and risk to existing customers.

options.title: Annual discount callout
options.description: Fastest test: make the annual savings clearer on pricing without changing plans.

options.title: Starter plan trial
options.description: Could widen top-of-funnel, but risks anchoring new users too low.

options.title: Usage-based overages
